has a Powerbase:Montreal.

2.If he could, and if the blood reaches the
capacity of the vampire, will it move to his

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
el...@my-deja.com wrote:
> I brainwashed a vampire of my prey. But my prey
> has a Powerbase:Montreal.
>
> 1.Can my prey still move blood to that vampire?

Yes. Brainwash only prevents her from making transfers.
I won't stop PB: Montreal, superior Govern the Unaligned,
etc.

> 2.If he could, and if the blood reaches the
> capacity of the vampire, will it move to his
> controlled region?

Yes.
